newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed in quiet markets.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed in quiet markets.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday in quiet markets, traders said.
Gasoline was firmer in with a Eurograde barge trading at $198.50 fob ARA for delivery up to May 10.
Naphtha was also stronger as buying interest emerged. Pipeline spec cargoes were bid around $179 cif NWE.
High sulphur barges were talked around $82 fob ARA but no trades were seen. Bunker demand was poor. A holiday in Italy slowed Mediterranean trade.
Heating oil was pulled $1.50 firmer on stronger futures while diesel also gained $1-2 on premiums due to tight supplies.
